allowCustomPersonalRoomURL.description: Allow hosts to change their Personal Room URLs.

allowCallIn.description: Whether call-in teleconferencing for sessions was enabled.

allowCallBack.description: Whether call-back teleconferencing for sessions was enabled.

allowOtherTeleconf.description: Whether other teleconferencing for sessions was enabled.

allowTollFreeCallin.description: Whether toll-free call-in teleconferencing was enabled.

allowInternationalCallin.description: Whether international call-in teleconferencing was enabled.

allowInternationalCallback.description: Whether international call-back teleconferencing was enabled.

VoIP.description: Whether Voice Over IP functionality using the attendee computer's speakers and microphones was enabled.

telephonyConfig.description: Telephony Configuration on WebEx Super Admin (These options are read-only, unable to update by Update Common Settings API).

entryAndExitTone.description:
Determines if a sound is made when someone enters or exits.
 * `NoTone` - No tone.
 * `Beep` - Beep.
 * `AnnounceName` - Announce name.

joinTeleconfNotPress1.description: Specifies whether or not joining teleconference without pressing 1 is checked by default.

telephonySupport.description:
Specifies the type of teleconference support for meetings.
 * `None` - None.
 * `WebexTeleconferencing` - Webex teleconferencing.
 * `Other` - Other Teleconferencing.

tollFree.description: Specifies whether toll-free call-in is available.

VoIP.description: Denotes if VoIP protocols are being used.

defaultSchedulerOptions.description: Default Scheduler Options on Webex Administration (These options are applied to the site as defaults, but individual users can change them).

emailReminders.description: Determines if email reminders are to be sent out.

scheduleMeetingOptions.description: Schedule Meeting Options on Webex Administration.

joinBeforeHost.description: Allow attendees or panelists to join before the host.

audioBeforeHost.description: Allows attendees or panelists to join the teleconference before the host.

firstAttendeeAsPresenter.description: Allows first attendee or panelist as the presenter.

unlistAllMeetings.description: Specifies that all meetings must be unlisted.

requireLoginBeforeAccess.description: Determines if a user must login before getting site access.

requireStrongPassword.description: Determines if strict passwords are required for meetings.

mixedCase.description: Determines if a password requires mixed case.

minNumeric.description: Sets the minimum number of numeric characters in the password.

minAlpha.description: Sets the minimum number of alphabetical characters in the password.

minSpecial.description: Sets the minimum number of special characters in the password.

disallowDynamicWebText.description: Do not allow dynamic web page text for meeting passwords (like site name, host's name, username, meeting topic).

disallowList.description: Specifies if passwords from the `disallowValues` list are to be allowed.

disallowValues.description: Sets password values that are not allowed.
